description: Apex tests that fail on aer, the local Apex runtime, and pass in a Salesforce org. scripts/aer-run.js --gate fails on any other failure and on a test that reports no result. Categories: "runtime gap" (aer behaves differently from Salesforce, shown), "profile" (the copy has no profiles folder) and "unclassified" (the cause is not yet known).

failures.error: Passes in a Salesforce org. In user mode, Salesforce refuses a selected toLabel(Lookup__r.Picklist__c) when the user cannot read Lookup__c; aer 1.6.9 answers it. Not yet filed upstream. First error on aer: System.AssertException: Assertion Failed: Assertion failed: Expected user mode to refuse the selected toLabel(Lookup__r.Picklist__c) shownLabel; it returned 1 rows

Passes in a Salesforce org. In user mode, Salesforce refuses a sort on a field of a parent record that the user cannot read; aer 1.6.9 answers it. Not yet filed upstream. First error on aer: System.AssertException: Assertion Failed: Assertion failed: Expected user mode to refuse the sort on the type of the account; it returned 1 rows

Passes in a Salesforce org. In user mode, Salesforce refuses a selected Event.What.Name when the user cannot read WhatId; aer 1.6.9 answers it. Not yet filed upstream. First error on aer: System.AssertException: Assertion Failed: Assertion failed: Expected user mode to refuse the selected Event.What.Name; it returned 1 rows

Passes in a Salesforce org. In user mode, Salesforce refuses a TYPEOF whose WHEN branch names an object the user cannot read; aer 1.6.9 answers it. Not yet filed upstream. First error on aer: System.AssertException: Assertion Failed: Assertion failed: Expected user mode to refuse the TYPEOF with an Account branch; it returned 1 rows

Passes in a Salesforce org. A filter on Who.Phone being empty, read through the shared Name record, returns the Event in Salesforce; aer 1.6.9 returns no row. Not yet filed upstream. First error on aer: System.AssertException: Assertion Failed: Expected the filter on the phone of the Name record to read the Event, sharing bypassed: true: Expected: 1, Actual: 0

Passes in a Salesforce org. A filter on Who.LastName, read through the shared Name record, returns the Event in Salesforce; aer 1.6.9 returns no row. Not yet filed upstream. First error on aer: System.AssertException: Assertion Failed: Expected the filter on the last name of the lead to read the Event, sharing bypassed: true: Expected: 1, Actual: 0

Passes in a Salesforce org. For a Minimum Access user, the Apex describe of the shared Name record marks RecordTypeId not readable in Salesforce; aer 1.6.9 marks it readable, so the builder does not refuse and the query fails instead. Not yet filed upstream. First error on aer: System.AssertException: Assertion Failed: The provided object is not an instance of class UTIL_Exceptions.IllegalStateException: Expected the refusal for the sort on What.RecordTypeId. Actual: System.QueryException: No such column 'RecordTypeId' on entity 'Name'.

Passes in a Salesforce org. Salesforce reads What.ProfileId on the shared Name record; aer 1.6.9 looks for ProfileId on Account, the related object, so the query fails. Not yet filed upstream. First error on aer: System.QueryException: No such column 'ProfileId' on entity 'Account'.

Passes in a Salesforce org. A TYPEOF whose WHEN branch names Location reaches the access check, which refuses it with a QueryException; aer 1.6.10 to 1.6.16 count System.Location as an SObject type (SObject.class.isAssignableFrom), so the name resolves to System.Location and a TypeException is thrown first. Fixed in aer 1.7.4 (pre-release, 2026-11-18); not filed upstream. First error on aer: System.TypeException: Invalid conversion from runtime type System.Location to SObject

Passes in a Salesforce org. The describe finds the Location object even though Location is also the name of a System type; aer 1.6.10 to 1.6.16 count System.Location as an SObject type (SObject.class.isAssignableFrom), resolve the name to it and fail the cast. Fixed in aer 1.7.4 (pre-release, 2026-11-18); not filed upstream. First error on aer: System.TypeException: Invalid conversion from runtime type System.Location to SObject
